notes.title: The character: Eva
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220481/9a3cbd13af0bdfb993f35692c643331221df8774.png[/img]  
- EVA - Today, I’m introducing the character EVA.  
Eva is your ex-girlfriend. She is a strong and independent woman, but she is still in love with you. Behind her confident facade lies a fragility she doesn't show to anyone. Even though your relationship has ended, Eva remains an important person in your life.  

She secretly hopes that you can regain what you’ve lost. Her glances, often filled with nostalgia, betray the feelings she tries to hide. Despite the emotional distance, there is still an undeniable connection between the two of you, even if it complicates your interactions.  

Moreover, everything seems to suggest that the world itself doesn’t want you to get closer. Obstacles, often inexplicable, arise every time you try to rebuild a deeper bond. But why? Is it mere coincidence, or is there an invisible force trying to keep you apart? Doubt sets in, and with it, a mystery that could very well change the very nature of your relationship. What if it’s not just chance? What if there’s something more?  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220481/ed03638da7bc87f22db7d3bfe4998c158d7c5cd9.jpg[/img]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220481/9304e2eb1f951b71c83357ec95183bdedbf691a3.png[/img]

notes.title: The Character: Vicky
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220481/631abe95fedac51db2e56620f36ccd49fb2a6d72.png[/img]

- VICKY - Today, I introduce you to the character VICKY.
Vicky is a complex character who, at first glance, gives the impression of being a superficial, plastic "bimbo," and a bit naïve. She often seems intrusive and displays an immediate, almost obsessive attachment. Yet, behind this facade, there might be an unexpected depth. Does Vicky simply have a need for affection, or is there a deeper reason behind her behavior?

She could well play a crucial role in the story, bringing unexpected elements and revealing hidden facets of herself.

notes.title: The character: Linda
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220481/e2f71e9702f3305d1e5c348b31c58731d2cebac9.png[/img]
- LINDA - Today, I’m introducing the character LINDA.  
Linda is a vibrant character. She stands out with her sharp sense of humor and rebellious nature. She never hesitates to speak her mind, displaying a disarming honesty. Although she appears independent and solitary at first glance, Linda is actually very social and finds comfort in the company of those she loves. Linda is a very important character ;)
